scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberate Paul Tol palette and semantic node encoding (hollow=expandable, filled=leaf, rank-colored) show real design intent, but the collapsed-count badges (+37, +16) render in the same coral as Phylum nodes creating a color collision, the tree occupies only the top half of the viewport leaving large dead space, and typography is uniformly sized with no hierarchy between rank levels.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Tree layout has no quantitative axes to deceive — categorical color and fixed-radius circles are honest; SVG dimensions are data-driven via d3.extent/d3.max; minor robustness risk from string-concatenated name+depth join keys instead of stable unique IDs.
scores.stress_test_note: No .interrupt() calls before starting new 500ms transitions on node clicks or expand/collapse buttons, so rapid interaction during a live transition causes element snapping; search is correctly debounced at 200ms and pointer events unify mouse/touch cleanly.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Single-view collapsible tree with 6-color rank legend, progressive disclosure via collapse, search highlighting, and descendant counts manages a large taxonomy (150+ total nodes) without overload — the default partial expansion shows only ~15 visible nodes at once, and color coding maps cleanly to a legible 6-rank legend.
